ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and lower regions, with 15% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized at the lateral lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the central peduncle and interior lobe surfaces. High-contrast white mottling with embedded dark circular points is located at the distal ends of both the left and right lobes (approx. 0-15% and 85-100% of the horizontal span).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 75 degrees; narrow vertex width relative to total fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; frequency increases towards the distal tips. Right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude, more jagged peaks (approx. 5-10 pixels in height) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep from the notch; trailing edge displays a sigmoid-like curve (initially concave near the notch, transitioning to convex toward the tips).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent circular high-contrast clusters (dark rings on white background) on the distal tips of both lobes; left tip contains approx. 6-8 distinct rosettes; right tip contains approx. 5-7 distinct rosettes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One clear, thin, diagonal linear pixel disruption (light gray) located on the right lobe, extending from the mid-lobe toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged indentation/loss of material at the extreme distal point of the right lobe trailing edge. Multiple circular depigmented scars (barnacle attachment sites) on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized concentration of white pigmentation and circular scarring at the outer tips, contrasting sharply with the uniform black of the rest of the visible fluke surface.
